newsitem.title: UK: LME copper slightly firmer in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper slightly firmer in late trading.

text.p: LME copper edged slightly higher in late trading on Tuesday after ending the afternoon kerb little changed.
At 1800 GMT three months metal was indicated at $2,365/68, compared to a kerb close of $2,360 which was up $4 from Monday.
The cash to threes backwardation was also a touch wider at $75/$80, after contracting sharply on Monday from a high of $210.
Aluminium, which has held up well despite copper's weakness, was also slightly firmer at $1,640/43, following a kerb close of $1,637.50.
